Crisis.title: Are you in an emergency?
Crisis.body: If you have thoughts of harming yourself or others, please call emergency services (112) immediately. This platform is not suitable for emergency or crisis intervention.

Home.heroSubtitle: Online individual psychological counseling and guidance with an expert counselor. In a safe and confidential setting, at a time that suits you.
Home.trust1Body: All sessions are conducted confidentially and encrypted, in line with data-protection law.
Home.trust2Body: Psychological counselor with a bachelor's and master's in Guidance & Counseling from Marmara University.
Home.trust3Body: Online sessions from anywhere, with flexible appointment times.
Home.how1: Sign up and complete the short pre-assessment
Home.how3: Choose a suitable appointment and complete payment via WhatsApp
Home.ctaTitle: Ready to take the first step?
Home.ctaBody: Start with a free intro call and let's assess together whether this process is right for you.
Home.disclaimer: This service falls under psychological counseling and guidance; it does not include medical diagnosis, treatment, or medication advice.

Footer.disclaimer: This website does not provide emergency/crisis intervention. In emergencies, call 112.
